issue.description:
ADR-001 (Accepted) specifies a third dependency kind, `verifies`, so authors can declare a check relationship and inversion of verification gates can be diagnosed structurally; it is scoped as post-0.1 item R025. No open bead in the queue tracks it. Close the gap by: implementing the `verifies` kind in the store schema and validation (cycle rejection rules unchanged); reporting the diagnosis (a `blocks` edge whose blocker `verifies` its blocked bead) as an advisory output in doctor/reporting surfaces — never rejecting the edge at insert and never inferring the relationship from titles; adding conformance and concurrency tests per the engineering rules; and updating help, the capability document, and the schema field guide to document the new kind.
